description:
Deliverables:
- Freeze the current per-key ownership model as the V1 contract.
- Ensure runtime role, epoch, sequence, and ownership summary semantics are documented and reflected in .spec.
- Clarify that raw pids are not the cross-node stability boundary.

Acceptance:
- Jido.Cluster.* public contract is stable enough for downstream work.
- Specs describe it explicitly.
- No further structural renames are required before Bedrock durability work.
title: Lock ownership and runtime contract
